recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見一團緊密黏聚（cohesive）的中型異常細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質少而淡藍，與周圍散在造血細胞不同，提示非造血性轉移腫瘤（此例為肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Cohesive cluster of medium-sized malignant cells with nuclear molding
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm, with a few small vacuoles
Separate small clusters of similar atypical cells at left
Hemodilute background; red cells show refractile drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background in which a cohesive cluster of medium-sized atypical cells is present, with additional small groups of similar cells nearby. The cells have round nuclei with finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles. The dot-like red cell inclusions are consistent with drying artifact. The cohesive clustering favors a non-hematopoietic small round cell tumor; in this clinical context the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, to be confirmed by biopsy with myogenin/desmin immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are dispersed as single cells without cohesive clusters and express TdT/CD34/CD19, whereas rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin and myogenin positive.
Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with fibrillary neuropil and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive, lacking myogenic markers.
Ewing sarcoma cells often have PAS-positive glycogen vacuoles and strong membranous CD99 with NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement, rather than PAX3/7::FOXO1 fusions.
Burkitt cells are discohesive with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and express CD20/CD10 with MYC rearrangement.
